diagrams.aria: Since the last publish, newest first. Oct 18: The pages showed what the system does, not whether it gets better; built: This page: every number re-runs from its command. Oct 17: Lessons were lost between one session and the next, where a one-session retro can't see; built: project-introspect: a retro across every session. Oct 15: A journey program can look healthy while doing nothing: it takes in participants and sends nothing, and the vendor's analytics show one program at a time; built: Engagement dashboards with health signals; they caught a live program failing silently. Oct 15: Two audits in a row found the same four things by hand; built: An audit that finds those four things itself. Oct 12: An urgent fix had to be cherry-picked around work parked on dev; built: Long-lived branches; dev stays shippable. Oct 12: Every fix batch triggered another full code review; built: One code review per release. Oct 11: A round's checks lived in free prose that nothing could read; built: Checks recorded as states at every handoff. Oct 7: The reports missed journeys whose participants come from a Power List; built: Reports follow Power List journeys (v0.43.4).
